name: The Tower
subtitle: Strings · apathy
brief: Up the tower, where the strings are: plucked along their length, silent across it, tied off at pegs. The struggle: depression and the apathy that comes with it, when nothing seems worth playing. Stand-ins: the Triad, the Stand and the Stair (the Bell Tower), and Strings 01, which lives in the Undercroft today.

scenes.title: The Ascent
scenes.say: A long pipe straight up the inside of the tower.
scenes.brief: Upright run that climbs (the right-hand lanes more and more), the first time you walk from Brass 03 into the Triad.

scenes.title: The Tower
scenes.name: The Tower
scenes.theme: Apathy, and the grey that comes with it
scenes.say: Oh. A visitor. I would get up, but... I would get up.

scenes.title: The Tower: the rooms
scenes.brief: About thirty-five minutes of string puzzles. Stand-in rooms are real, playable rooms from the prototype dungeon; the wing's other ~25 minutes are uncarved. The stand-ins are horn and fork rooms more than string rooms: the strings themselves have the least puzzle built on them so far.
notes: Suggested shape for every wing, Nintendo's four steps per mechanic (kishotenketsu): introduce it where it is safe, develop it, twist it, then a room that uses all of it at once.
The stand-in rooms are in G mixolydian (confident). The wing probably wants something greyer.

scenes.title: The Tuning Bow
scenes.name: the Tuning Bow
scenes.say: Midway up the Tower you would find its instrument. A guess: a bow that draws tension back into slack strings, so a string that has stopped sounding can be made to sing again.
scenes.brief: A guess at the Tower's instrument: apathy undone a string at a time.

scenes.title: The Slack
scenes.name: The Slack
scenes.intro: ...is there any point? You will play it, and then it will be over, and then what.
scenes.resolve: ...that one hurt a little. In a good way. Like a string coming back up to pitch.
scenes.brief: Apathy as a slack string. The notes come in grey and the lanes sag, and every phase the tempo drags lower. The last phase is long held notes: all you have to do is keep holding on. Resolving brings the tempo back up.
notes: Aeolian (sad) resolving to dorian: still minor, with a lift in it.

phases.say: Go on, then. I will just... be here.
It is getting slower. Everything does.

scenes.title: After the Slack
scenes.brief: The strings across the stair pull tight, one at a time. Not happiness: a sound, which is a start.

shots.say: One by one, the strings across the stair pull tight. They do not make you happy. They make a sound, which is a start.
I think I will practise. Not today. Maybe today.
